name: Euro-area economy
summary: Euro-area Q3 GDP +0.4% and October composite PMI 51.9, above Normal lines; Eurostat's next GDP estimate due 13 Nov
state: Eurostat's preliminary flash estimate of 30 Oct put euro-area GDP growth at 0.4% in Q3 and 1.3% on a year earlier (Eurostat). The October flash composite PMI of 51.9 remains above 50. A Reuters poll published on 12 Nov found economists raising 2026 growth forecasts to 1.1% while expecting an ECB rate rise in December with inflation at 4% in October; Eurostat's next GDP estimate is due on 13 Nov.
for_you: Euro-area growth is positive. Households and firms with variable-rate loans are exposed to the expected rise in ECB rates, and inflation near twice the target is squeezing real incomes.
rubric_hit: Normal: GDP +0.4% q/q (positive) and composite PMI 51.9 > 50

sources.title: Eurostat — GDP up by 0.4% in the euro area and by 0.5% in the EU
Investing.com (Reuters) — ECB set for last rate hike in December but inflation risks keep door open for one more: Reuters poll

why: The euro area is the UK's largest trading partner; stagnation there hits UK exports and European markets.
drivers: Energy prices, German industry, ECB policy, fiscal rules, China demand.

rubric.alert: Technical recession, or PMI < 45, or bond-spread fragmentation forcing ECB action.
rubric.normal: Positive GDP growth and composite PMI > 50.
